newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nortel seen investing $30 mln in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Nortel seen investing $30 mln in Mexico.

text.p: Canada's Northern Telecom (Nortel) is expected to expand its operations in the industrial northern Mexican state of Nuevo Leon with a $30 million investment, a state government official said on Wednesday.
The state's head of Economic Development Roberto Rodriguez said the investment was announced by David Winfield, a high-level Nortel executive and former ambassador to Canada in Mexico.
It was expected "in the very short term", Rodriguez said, and would create some 600 jobs, in addition to the 1,500 already employed here.

Rodriguez was speaking at a news conference after a mission of Canadian businessmen to the Nuevo Leon capital of Monterrey. Mexico this year opened-up long-distance telecommunications traffic to competition, breaking the monopoly of Telefonos de Mexico.
